hook: Wednesday night rain soaks Medak's harvested paddy
hook_b: Wednesday night rain soaks Medak's harvested paddy
tldr: Unseasonal rain lashed parts of Medak district on Wednesday night, damaging standing paddy and harvested grain left out to dry.

beats.what: Paddy brought to procurement centres and drying platforms was hit, along with crops ready for harvest.
beats.why: Harvested paddy is spread out in the open to dry before it is bought, so a night of rain can sweep it away.
beats.care: A video of a farmer crying over a tractor load of swept-away paddy went viral; several farmers reported similar losses.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: A tenant farmer from Konapur woke on Thursday to find more than half of his two truckloads of harvest washed away.

cards.q: Should procurement centres have covered drying platforms?

qs: Who bears the loss when paddy is damaged while waiting at a procurement centre?

facts.t: The farmer had leased *two acres* and got two truckloads of harvest before the rain.

viz.verdict: The loss is two-thirds of what he spent, he told Telangana Today.

watch: Whether officials assess the losses at Medak's procurement centres.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Unseasonal rains cause huge losses to farmers in Medak

fact: Untimely rain in Medak damaged paddy drying at *procurement centres* on Wednesday night
twist: One tenant farmer in Ramayampet mandal said he lost over *₹40,000* of a ₹60,000 two-acre crop.
